preconditions.description: The number of nodes N must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U <= N and 1 <= V <= N for U, V in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints U and V must be valid node indices between 1 and N.
The number of edges must be exactly N - 1 for a valid tree structure.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of connected components achievable after applying the operation.
